method: Same rule as scorecard-sources.json. Each new source was looked up by DOI on Crossref (title plus subtitle; Unicode dashes split as spaces), falling back to Crossref bibliographic search; verified only when title token overlap >= 0.75 both ways, the first author is among the record's authors and the year is within one. Abstracts came from Semantic Scholar (batch API), Crossref or Europe PMC (OpenAlex was over its free daily budget). Numbers in claims were matched against the abstract text. Status no-abstract: the abstract could not be retrieved, so the source is used only for what its title states or as background. web-secondary: the number comes from a secondary summary, not the paper.
